thatoneMD wrote
naytai wrote
Has anyone made or found a patch for Wonder Boy in Monster Land to use the Mega Drive controller Start button as Pause?

I made one (attached).


Does anybody know where a patch for Teddy Boy is? I own it both physically and have tried multiple roms via everdrive as well and it's always the same. Play with a Genesis/Megadrive controller and it does the same thing that happened to most of the other incompatible games before I patched them. Unfortunately, this one is the only game who's patch eludes me. If anybody here could help me out it would be much appreciated! Thank you!
